QuestInfo.name: Mr. Pickall the Lock-picker
QuestInfo.0: Ask Mr. Pickall about the Old Gold Watch.
QuestInfo.1: Mr. Pickall will tell you where the Old Gold Watch is... for a price. He needs materials to make a key for a particularly tricky lock. Go to the either #b#m103020100##k or #b#m103020200##k and gather #b5 Useful Scrap Irons#k.
QuestInfo.2: You gave the materials to Mr. Pickall, and he gave you the Old Gold Watch.

0.0: Yes, yes, spit it out! What's the matter?\r\n#L0##bUmm, did anyone sell you an Old Gold Watch?#l\n#k
0.1: Sure, sure. But what'll you give me if I do?\r\n#L0##bGive you? I don't really have a lot of money...#l\n#k
0.2: No money, eh? I'm sure we can work something out...

yes.0: I can pick any lock! Any lock in the world! But there's this one box I can't get open. My name's on the line, here! And let me tell you, nobody wants to deal with Mr. Pickmost!
yes.1: I need to craft a new key, but I don't have right materials with me now. So, I want you to go find them for me. #b#rScrap Irons#k from #m103020100##k or #b#m103020200##k will do the trick.

no.0: I guess you don't really want that Old Gold Watch back, do you?

1.0: You have the iron for my key yet?

yes.0: Good, good! Give me a second to open up this box, and then we'll talk.

item.0: I think #b5#k Scrap Irons for 1 Old Gold Watch is a fair deal, don't you?
